# PROPOSAL-NNN: Proposal Title

> Replace every placeholder before publication. A Proposal explains why this
> work matters; it does not authorize implementation.

## Summary

Briefly describe the problem or opportunity and desired outcome.

## Problem

Describe the current problem without prescribing architecture.

## Motivation

Explain why GiftUI should address it now. For MVP work, identify the concrete
reference-application or stack-validation requirement from `MVP_SCOPE.md`.

## Users / Use Cases

Identify affected users, platforms, and representative scenarios.

## Non-goals

- Explicitly excluded outcome.

class design.

- Risk and why it matters.
